_doc: SOTA generative/shader techniques distilled as CONCEPTS (not code). The loop reinterprets each as ORIGINAL three.js particle art. NEVER reproduce any existing shader's source. Refresh by distilling current Shadertoy 'shader of the week' techniques (titles only) when available.

techniques.concept: warp the particle sample coordinates by a second, slower noise field (warp-of-a-warp) so the form folds back on itself; layered and deliberate, never a flat curl-haze
distribute particles ON the isosurface of a signed-distance field (gyroid, menger sponge, or mandelbulb) — sample the surface as points, do not raymarch pixels
drive particle density and color by a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field so coral/leopard/labyrinth patterns emerge over time
partition the particle field into Worley/Voronoi cells with bright crack borders and dim interiors — reads as cracked clay or cell tissue
displace a particle sheet by fractal-brownian-motion ridged noise so it reads as an eroded ridge/terrain seen at a grazing angle
route particle strands along a truchet-tile curve network (random arc tiles) so threads weave a continuous labyrinth
merge nearby particle clusters into implicit metaball blobs that bulge and separate — organic, mercurial coalescence
particles trace caustic light ribbons (the bright folded curves light makes through water) — thin, bright, curved filaments on dark
fold the point cloud through an iterated-function-system (affine contractions + rotation) so a self-similar fractal structure emerges
sample particles from the signed-distance field of calligraphic glyphs / Arabic or CJK script so language becomes the form (language-as-material)
advect particle dye through a stable-fluids (Navier-Stokes) velocity field with vortices — smoke/ink that curls and dissipates with real fluid feel
place particles on an aperiodic Penrose / quasicrystal tiling so the lattice never repeats yet stays ordered
run curl-noise flow but CONSTRAIN it inside a recognizable silhouette (a hand, a leaf, a creature) so motion is energetic but the shape stays legible — never an unbounded nebula
trace a less-common strange attractor (Thomas, Halvorsen, Dadras, Sprott) rather than Lorenz/Aizawa, for an unfamiliar but clearly mathematical shape
arrange particles on a Poincare-disk hyperbolic tiling so cells shrink toward the rim — non-Euclidean, infinite-edge composition
build a form by CSG boolean ops on SDF primitives (smooth-min union/subtraction) and clothe the resulting surface in particles — a carved, solid object
